title: Digital research collection highlights Pauling celebration
notes: Confirms 46 research notebooks, 1922-1994, about 7,500 pages, containing calculations, experimental data, conclusions and future research ideas. Use as archive map, not as primary evidence for a specific decision.

title: The Structure of Proteins: Two Hydrogen-Bonded Helical Configurations of the Polypeptide Chain
notes: Publication metadata verified; full episode still requires primary-source line/page review and contemporaneous notebook/correspondence linkage.

title: Linus Pauling and the Structure of Proteins: A Documentary History
notes: Documentary-history gateway with hundreds of letters, manuscripts, papers, photographs and AV material. Individual primary records must be separately registered before direct citation.

title: Sickle Cell Anemia, a Molecular Disease
notes: Team-authored paper. Do not attribute the experimental program solely to Pauling.

title: A Proposed Structure for the Nucleic Acids
notes: Published proposed triple-chain model. Pair with OSU contemporaneous notes/correspondence before inferring the decision process.

title: Linus Pauling and the Race for DNA: A Documentary History
notes: Gateway to hundreds of original letters, lab notes, photographs and manuscripts; direct primary objects must be separately registered.

title: Modern Structural Chemistry
notes: Retrospective synthesis. Useful for Pauling's stated structural-chemistry framework, but not sufficient alone to reconstruct earlier decisions.
